parameters.content:
## YouTube Publisher

Publishes Content Calendar rows to YouTube every 5 minutes.

**Picks up a row when ALL are true:** Status is Approved or Retry Pending; Platforms contains youtube; YouTube Status does not start with Posted; Drive File ID is set; Scheduled DateTime has passed (or is empty).

Only owns the YouTube Status column. Retries up to 3 times (15/30/45 min back-off), then marks the row Failed and emails the admin.

**Upload settings:** category 27 (Education), region IN, privacy PUBLIC, subscribers notified. Set privacyStatus to private on "Upload to YouTube" while testing.

Imported INACTIVE. Publishing it posts real videos to the chambers channel.
